Niger.title: Niger-EU: Niamey raises its voice after statements on the Algerian military deployment
Niger.summary: The reception of the European Chargé d 'affaires by the Nigerien Prime Minister on 9 November illustrates the tensions aroused by Brussels' requests for explanations on the deployment of Algerian soldiers in Niger, an initiative that Niamey considers to be fully within its sovereignty . The Prime Minister of Niger, Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine, received Monday, November 9, 2026 the Chargé d 'affaires of the European Union (EU) in Niamey, following statements by the spokesperson of the European Commission on the deployment of Algerian military units in Niger .

Niger.title: A European request that angered Algeria about the deployment of its army in Niger
Niger.summary: The EU's request for clarifications on sending Algerian military units to Niger has sparked controversy and drawn widespread criticism in Algerian media and political circles. The European Union Spokesman for Foreign Affairs, Policy and Security Affairs expressed the Union's concern and follow-up to the Algerian military move and the deployment of army units in Nigerian territory The European Union is awaiting clarifications from Algeria on the deployment of units of the Algerian army in Niger, the extent, objective and basis of this deployment, the European official said in press statements.
